author: San_David
body:
To be perfectly honest with you all, I've been a little dissatisfied with the ranged classes in Nexus. I feel as if they're a little too weak, and have very little staying power as a whole, which is something they need in Nexus' fast-paced, teamfighty gameplay. Playing them as almost like holding a ticking time-bomb...once you run out of arrows, you're basically a sitting duck.

Another problem I see with the two kits is that Sniper is, more or less, a superpowered (if you could call it that) version of Archer. Faster, more arrows, more power, more armor...everything about Sniper is better than Archer. I honestly think that the two classes should be a bit more unique.

So, here's my suggestions for ranged combat...

+ Buff Archer
  - Infinity Bow, no other enchantments
  - Wood Sword
  - Speed I
  - Leather Hat, Chestpiece, Boots (5 Armor Points)

Basically, what I'm going for with this Archer build is mobility. The Archer can stay in the fight for a while, and if he runs into trouble, he can retreat with greater ease than most other classes.

+ Change Sniper
  - Punch, Power I Bow
  - 64 Arrows / 32 Arrows, gain 8 arrows per kill
  - Stone Sword / Knockback I Wood Sword (respective to bullet above)
  - No potion effects
  - Chain Chestpiece, Boots; Leather Hat (7 Armor Points)

With this build, the Sniper is now a bulkier, more powerful Archer, but it sacrifices the mobility and staying power that the Archer has. There's two options that I thought of for the Sniper. One is where the Sniper has a limited amount of arrows, but a more powerful sword. The other is an option where the Sniper can gain arrows if he gets kills. The sword is less powerful, but it could be good for driving away enemies or putting them in a comfortable bow range.

+ Add CTH's Mage
  - Change Medic unlock level to 7, Viper to 11, Sniper to 17
  - Unlock Mage at Level 14

I think this would be a good idea for another ranged class. The Mage should be able to hold it's own in Nexus, and it'll decrease the amount of sword fights as well, which would make Nexus a little less repetitive. Variety is good.

Also, please no tl;dr. Please. D=

title: [Nexus] Ranged Class Changes / Buffs

replies.author: build_high
replies.body:
I like sniper the way it is because it will lose most 1v1s but win most range duels. It's a fun kit and works well

as for archer I believe it should have infinity and possibly speed 1.

as for Mage I believe it would be a good kit to add into nexus with a little tweaking but the kit levels should stay the same.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
Archer would be good, but switch the levels with medic. (Medic at level 4, archer at level 8). Also, to nerf it a tad, take away leggings. That way you can snipe but have to be careful of melee

There are already complaints about sniper being OP. 64 arrows is a lot. And the gold sword does wood damage (...usually...there are exceptions) Nevertheless, I like your idea with 1 change. 

I would suggest taking away punch 1 from sniper and  give it infinity. 

Adding mage age would be good, just make it so you can knock fireballs back. And no fire aspect :0

replies.author: Phobiaxx
replies.body:
I think sniper should be changed to:
Bow:Power 1
Arrows:50, add 15 to every kill
leather boots-1/2 armor point(i think)
Wooden Sword:Sharpness -3, knockback 2, 1 time use, regenerates after 3 kills, or 1 minute.
grass block: ability: cloak, 6 seconds, cooldown:10 seconds, or 1 kill.(cloak also cloaks sniper's weapons)
This will make sniper's more realistic, snipers are supposed to camoflauge, because without it, they would be weak.
Snipers need more shots tho, otherwise, to me, sniper isn't O.P at all, but crummy.
The sword is just a tool for the sniper to make a getaway.. dealing only 1 damage
It can be used for snipers to knock an enemy far back, and shoot him dead.
Sniper would have strong offensive power, but extremely weak defensive, they will be able to get 2-hit by virtually any class.
one last thing:
ability:speed boost, have a feather in their inventory, when left clicked, they will have speed for 8 seconds, regenerates after 3 kills, or 2 minutes.
what do you guys think? :D

replies.author: San_David
replies.body:
@build_high The Archer I proposed already has Speed I / Infinity. For the Sniper...some other people are suggesting a debuff for it, so I decided to try to do so.

@kycrafft Hmm...I think the levels are fine as is. New players who don't like sword combat would be able to switch over to ranged combat early, instead of having to keep using a bulkier sword class.

As for it being OP...well...I dunno. We'd have to see, but I think the decreased armor should be enough. Plus, I hate the 'ticking time-bomb' factor (explained earlier) that Sniper has, so the arrows alleviate that. Of course, it could keep the 32 arrows, but gain 8 arrows every time the Sniper gets a kill? Could work.

Infinity would probably push Sniper over the 'OP Edge;' Punch doesn't do much anyways.

As for the Gold Sword... I didn't know that! I also didn't consider that the sword has an extremely low durability, so... Wood it is. I was thinking of adding Sharpness I to it too, but that'd make it stronger than a stone sword. Maybe a regular stone sword would work, though... I don't know.

@TheRomanTrident Ehh... a little too overcomplicated. The cloak would be way too overpowered, and, as far as I know, not possible (Invisibility can't cloak armor). The sword is cool, but fairly useless if the Sniper gets 2HKO'd.

As a whole, I think it'd be overdoing it a bit. I'm just trying to go for equipment changes, but not attempting to change the Sniper entirely.
